summary: First iteration full backend + frontend end-to-end testing of ZOPIN hyperlocal commerce app. 20/20 backend pytest cases pass (auth, shops, products, cart, checkout/orders, order-status flow, admin toggle, role guards, Claude AI description). Full consumer purchase flow (login -> shop -> add-to-cart -> checkout -> order placed -> ZP order#) verified in UI. Merchant flow verified: login -> dashboard KPIs/revenue chart -> inventory (10 seeded) -> create product with AI-generated description (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations, response ~5s) -> save (10->11) -> Orders page shows consumer order with Accept/Reject -> Shop profile loads -> Analytics renders 'Revenue' chart with no errors -> logout redirects to /login. Admin login -> /admin/dashboard shows platform KPIs (revenue, shops, orders, products, consumers, merchants) -> /admin/shops lists Fresh Basket. Auth cookies are httpOnly (SameSite=None, Secure) verified. Role guards enforced (consumer->/shops/mine=403, merchant->/admin/stats=403). Admin suspend of shop removes it from public GET /api/shops/, approve restores it.

integration_issues.issue: Delivery OTP is issued by backend (verified via API) but not prominently displayed on the order confirmation / OrderDetail page. Review request explicitly asks the page to show delivery OTP. Consider adding a labelled section like 'Delivery OTP: 1234'.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Display delivery_otp field on the consumer OrderDetail / order confirmation page so the customer can share it with delivery agent.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: bcrypt used correctly, hashes start with $2b$. seed_admin is idempotent and updates password if changed. Good.
cookies set httpOnly, secure, SameSite=None correctly for cross-site cookie auth (frontend + backend on same origin via ingress; still safe).
CORS: allow_origins uses explicit FRONTEND_URL + http://localhost:3000 with allow_credentials=True. Correct.
Brute force lockout implemented (5 attempts / 15 min window).
ObjectId is properly stringified in all _*_out helpers; no raw _id leaks observed.
order_routes.checkout: currently a consumer can pass any address/phone; that's OK for MVP but consider server-side normalization. Delivery fee free above 499, GST 5% flat: acceptable for MVP.
product_routes._product_out spreads all Mongo fields except _id; this exposes fields like shop_id/shop_name which is expected. Fine.
ai_routes uses emergentintegrations with claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929; requires merchant role. Verified working end-to-end.
No file exceeds ~200 lines. DRY reasonable. No blocking sync IO.
test_credentials: admin@zopin.com / Admin@123 ; merchant@test.com / Test@1234 ; consumer@test.com / Test@1234 (all pre-seeded and working)
seed_data_creation: None created by tester (Fresh Basket shop + 10 products + merchant/consumer already pre-seeded by backend). Test artifacts: transient TEST_UI_Product created and one TEST_Milk in pytest CRUD (Milk deleted; UI TEST_UI_Product remains in inventory as of test end - inventory now 11 rows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All major flows are green. If retesting, note that a leftover 'TEST_UI_Product' may exist in the merchant inventory from this run (safe to delete). Backend regression tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and can be run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs blocking. Only optional enhancement: show delivery_otp on the OrderDetail page.
